revised_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: iOS app icon candidate, square 1024x1024 raster image
Primary request: Generate candidate A for the Chinese iOS app "步履小屋". Create a cozy watercolor travel app icon that feels lighter and less crowded than the previous version.
Subject: a small warm tiny cabin, one folded paper plane, and one pair of footprint marks. No other objects.
Style/medium: premium simplified watercolor travel-journal icon, soft pencil outline, warm paper texture, crisp silhouette, readable at phone home-screen size.
Composition/framing: square canvas, no rounded corners baked into the image. Put the cabin centered slightly low, occupying only about 62-68% of the canvas width and height, with 14-18% clear safe margin on all sides for iOS rounded-corner cropping. Paper plane floats near upper-right but stays well inside the safe area; footprints sit below the cabin but do not touch the bottom edge. Full-bleed warm cream paper background, not an inner card.
Lighting/mood: warm, cozy, calm, inviting.
Color palette: warm cream background, honey window glow, warm browns, muted sage/olive roof accents. No blue, no purple, no dark navy.
Materials/textures: subtle watercolor wash and paper grain; clean edges; no tiny details.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers.
Constraints: icon must remain visually balanced with generous padding; no border, no drop shadow, no visible rounded rectangle, no white corner cutouts, no scenery, no plants, no clouds, no Apple logo, no Health icon, no watermark.
